messages:
Rhea: quick heads-up 84			Opening a small docs PR to standardize header names and example queries for quotas/rate limits.
Jon: ID? i'll take an early look.
Rhea: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4691 - WIP. changes: rename X-Cust-Tier -> X-Rw-Billing-Tier, update python/js sdk snippets, add a short migration checklist, and a worked example for burst accounting.
Priya: do we need to call out any behavioral change? iirc hosted still ignores the header.
Rhea: yes, made that explicit: "Hosted accounts: tier derived from account mapping; header honored only in dedicated/private override contexts."
Marco: for dashboards: our prom query references `tier` label in a few places. i'll grep the dash repo and send a patch to rename to `billing_tier` so panels don't break.
Rhea: thanks. also adding a one-hour aggregation example for alerts (teams asked for it).
Jon: can you paste the updated sdk snippet here so reviewers can sanity-check?
Rhea: python example: ```headers = { 'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}', 'X-Rw-Billing-Tier': 'enterprise' } # fallback: read X-Old-Tier for backward compat```
Priya: add a tiny middleware example that checks both keys so customer code keeps working during rollout.
Rhea: added middleware example: `tier = req.headers.get('x-rw-billing-tier') or req.headers.get('x-cust-tier') or derive_from_account(req.user)`
infra-bot: note: docs linter passed for modified pages.
Marco: dash PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dashboards/pull/84 - renames template var to `$billing_tier` and updates panel queries.
Rhea: one more thing: usage-export CSV column will change from `tier` -> `billing_tier` next Wed. added migration note and sample awk to remap: `awk -F, 'NR==1{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="tier") c=i} {if(c) $c=""; print}'` (suggested as guidance).
Jon: can you also show the burst math worked example? reviewers kept asking for numbers.
Rhea: included short worked example: "Silver: baseline 50 req/min, burst buffer 200 tokens. If steady traffic = 80 req/min, then 30 req/min draws from burst; after 6 minutes burst exhausted (200/30 ~= 6.66)."
Priya: add a tiny diagram? even ascii?
Rhea: added an ascii table + one-line formula: `burst_remaining = burst_credit - max(0, steady_rps - baseline_rps) * minutes`.
ops: FYI we'll coordinate the dashboard deploy same window as docs rebuild to avoid missing vars. ops suggests a 2 hour maintenance window.
Marco: scheduled dashboard deploy for 04/02 04:00 UTC. tagging ops.
Jon: left 3 tiny editorial comments in the PR about phrasing and the CSV awk example.
Rhea: fixed phrasing and swapped awk for csvkit example (`csvcut -c billing_tier,input.csv > out.csv`) per Jon's suggestion. pushed.
infra-bot: docs PR merged by Rhea 76; site rebuild queued.
ops: dashboard PR merged. deploy scheduled as above.
Priya: awesome. I made a tiny follow-up in the migration guide suggesting a deprecation timeline: "Old header accepted until 2026-05-15; after that it's ignored."
Rhea: added the deprecation date and a brief customer-facing note.
Jon: approved.
Rhea: closing thread 44D
